values.description: MeeSell backend base URL. Change to staging/prod URL as needed.
JWT access token — auto-populated by the OTP Verify test script. Never commit a real token.
Product UUID — set this after creating a product to use in product-scoped requests.
Export UUID — set this after initiating an export to poll its status.
HMAC-SHA256 signature for Razorpay webhook testing. Leave empty for local dev (signature verification may be bypassed in dev env).
